traits.name: Cunning of Kong
traits.text:
The heir has advantage on saving
throws against illusions and enchantments.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The heir makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft.,
one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range
30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning
damage.

actions.name: Psychic Blast (Recharge 6)
actions.text:
The heir emits a violent
wave of psychic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each
creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12
Intelligence saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic
damage and become stunned until the end of the
heir's next turn.
